findings.summary: The original submission (ART-20260906-059/060) had no change-set or validation-result artifact, despite the implementation plan and the commit message both promising the full spec/plan/change-set/validation-result discipline -- the one change in this batch that touched production directly and most needed a durable record.
findings.disposition: fixed -- this change-set and the accompanying validation-result (ART-20260906-064) are that record

findings.summary: The applied migration's own comment claims a sequential-scan query pattern on sowId that does not exist anywhere in this codebase (every sowId filter runs against an already-loaded in-memory WorkspaceState, never a SQL WHERE/JOIN).
findings.disposition: accepted, not fixed in the file -- the migration is already applied to production and prisma_migrations records its checksum; editing the file now would break every subsequent prisma migrate deploy against this database. ART-20260906-061 (spec v2) carries the corrected record instead.

findings.summary: The applied migration's own comment claims archiving a Sow row triggers the onDelete: Restrict constraint check -- archiving is a soft-delete UPDATE that touches no key column and never fires the check; only a genuine SQL DELETE does, which this application never issues on Sow outside test cleanup.
findings.disposition: accepted, not fixed in the file -- same checksum constraint as F2; corrected in ART-20260906-061

findings.summary: The plan's framing of running prisma migrate deploy directly from this session as a deliberate exception to the CI/CD pipeline overstated the deviation: docs/deployment.md's own section 3a states every release in this application's history has been made by hand, since the pipeline's deploy job has never actually run.
findings.disposition: fixed -- ART-20260906-062 (plan v2) corrects the framing

findings.summary: The plan's rollback note covered dropping the index from the database but not reconciling git history against the database's own _prisma_migrations record after a revert.
findings.disposition: fixed -- ART-20260906-062 adds the prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back step

findings.summary: This session's checks (migrate status, the three live-database proofs) ran against the already-migrated production database, not a full bootstrap-from-empty run -- the one gate CI's Verify job normally proves on every push (all 35 migrations applying cleanly to a fresh postgres:16 container) was not reproduced locally.
findings.file: N/A -- a process gap, not a file
findings.disposition: addressed by opening this PR -- CI's Verify job runs prisma migrate deploy against a fresh container as part of its normal push/PR trigger; its result is recorded in the validation-result (ART-20260906-064) rather than reproduced by hand

findings.summary: A pre-existing standing firewall rule permits this workstation's IP to reach the production Postgres server, unrelated to and predating this specific migration.
findings.file: N/A -- infrastructure posture, out of scope for this change
findings.disposition: not fixed -- correctly identified by the reviewer as a broader, pre-existing access posture question, not something introduced or worsened by this change; not actioned here
